config.label: App password
config.description: App password. Either this or EMAIL_PASSWORD_CMD is required, except with PROVIDER=outlook, which signs in through the browser.

config.label: One of gmail, outlook, icloud, yahoo, gmx, fastmail, mailbox
config.description: One of gmail, outlook, icloud, yahoo, gmx, fastmail, mailbox.org, posteo. Fills in IMAP, SMTP and Sieve hosts and ports.

config.label: IMAP hostname for self-hosted or unlisted providers
config.description: IMAP hostname for self-hosted or unlisted providers. Overrides the preset.

config.label: Comma-separated list of tiers beyond read, which is always included
config.description: Comma-separated list of tiers beyond read, which is always included. Defaults to drafts.

config.label: With PROVIDER=outlook only
config.description: With PROVIDER=outlook only. Application ID of an app registered in your organization's tenant.

config.label: With PROVIDER=outlook only
config.description: With PROVIDER=outlook only. Tenant ID or domain, for a single-tenant MS_CLIENT_ID.

config.label: Names of several accounts, separated by commas, each 1 to 16 lowercase letters or digits
config.description: Names of several accounts, separated by commas, each 1 to 16 lowercase letters or digits. Each account's settings then end in __ and its name in capitals, such as EMAIL_USER__WORK. Leave the unsuffixed account settings out.
